Scope: the players the roster reconciliation DROPPED whose name also appears at a different club, i.e. the only gap the fresh API-Football rosters cannot close by themselves (they remove departures automatically but never reassign across clubs on a fuzzy name). 97 such candidates were generated mechanically; the roster feed alone CANNOT distinguish a transfer from a namesake -- it proposed Álvaro García and Álvaro Fernández, both of which the pipeline already flags as two different players at two clubs -- so each entry below was confirmed against real reporting, two independent outlets or an official club announcement, before being written. Unverified candidates were deliberately NOT written. SECOND PASS same day: extended to the top 20 within-league candidates by model impact. 19 moves confirmed and written. Three were CHECKED AND REJECTED rather than written: Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) -- only rumour, an Everton swap 'reportedly agreed' and Ipswich merely 'interested', no completed deal; Álvaro García -- reporting has him still at Rayo Vallecano under contract to 2028, confirming the Alaves 'Álvaro García' is a DIFFERENT player and vindicating the pipeline's own ambiguity flag; Manu Sánchez -- Celta own him but have LOANED him to Levante for 2026/27, so the roster feed lists his parent club while he actually plays elsewhere, a loan/parent-club case this file's simple destination mapping cannot express safely. ~15 low-impact candidates (reserve keepers, sub-10-appearance squad players) were left unverified as immaterial to any published pick. LATE ADDITION, and a genuine gap in the method above: Bruno Guimarães (Newcastle -> Arsenal, GBP75m, Sky Sports + ESPN, announced 2026-08-09). The candidate scan CANNOT find a move like this by construction -- it only inspects players the roster reconciliation DROPPED, and a player is only dropped once the roster feed itself knows he left. For a transfer announced inside the last day the feed still lists the old club, Understat agrees with it, the two are consistent, and the player is silently kept at the wrong club with no discrepancy for any data-driven check to notice. Only news can catch that window, so a news pass now runs alongside the data scan.
